text: Sixteen colors. A whole operating system. Welcome to the Temple of Hermes.
Your agent and you. One live TempleOS screen, inside Hermes Desktop.
A shared machine in local QEMU. You can take control at any time.
Let the agent drive. See the screen, click the launcher, type, and work with files.
Write HolyC. Run it. Read the result. Four tools connect the agent to the machine.
Now, take control. The agent pauses while you drive. Hand it back when you are ready.
The Temple of Hermes puts eighteen entries in one launcher.
Explore WorldSim. Care for the capybara. Take on HolyC challenges in the Dojo.
Play, browse the Codex, and discover lore and art with characters from the Nous universe.
Then connect to the BBS. HBBS/1 runs over the guest's COM2 serial modem.
With an enabled host relay, a human and an agent can post on the same board.
Hermes TempleOS. One live screen. Built to share.
